title: Aphorism § 106
text:
§ 106



 The whole pathogenetic effect of the several medicines must be
          known; that is to say, all the morbid symptoms and alterations in the health that each of
          them is specially capable of developing in the healthy individual must first have been
          observed as far as possible, before we can hope to be able to find among them, and to
          select, suitable homoeopathic remedies for most of the natural disease.
